test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Matriculation Level) Official Paper (Held On: 20 Jun, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Stunning
solution:
The correct answer is: **Gorgeous**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"stunning"** means something extremely impressive or attractive. (अत्यंत प्रभावशाली या आकर्षक)

 
 
• **Example: **She looked **stunning **in her red dress.
 
 
 
• **"Gorgeous"** refers to something that is very beautiful or attractive. (बहुत सुंदर या आकर्षक)
 
 
• **Example: **The sunset over the ocean was absolutely **gorgeous**.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Ugly** (कुरूप): Unpleasant or repulsive, especially in appearance.

 
 
• **Example:** The old building was considered **ugly **by many.
 
 
 
• **Hideous** (भयंकर): Extremely ugly or disgusting.
 
 
• **Example:** The monster in the movie was **hideous **and terrifying.
 
 
 
• **Plain** (साधारण): Not decorated or elaborate; simple or basic in character.
 
 
• **Example:** She wore a **plain **white shirt to the interview.
